prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The spokesperson issued a brief _____ to clarify that the rumor about the factory closing was false.
options: statement
station
statue
stability

wrong.station: station 是「車站、站」，不是公司發出的聲明。
wrong.statue: statue 是「雕像」，只是拼字相近。
wrong.stability: stability 是「穩定」，不能 issue 一個 stability。

why: 發言人發出聲明來澄清謠言，issue a statement 是固定搭配。
tip: issue a statement = 發表聲明。
say: The spokesperson issued a brief statement to clarify that the rumor about the factory closing was false.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The company promised to investigate the complaint and take _____ action within a week.
options: appropriate
approximate
apparent
absolute

wrong.approximate: approximate 是「大約的」，不能形容 action 的適當性。
wrong.apparent: apparent 是「明顯的」，與採取行動是否合宜無關。
wrong.absolute: absolute 是「絕對的」，語氣太強且不是此處常見搭配。

why: take appropriate action 是公關聲明常用句，指採取適當的措施。
tip: take appropriate action = 採取適當行動。
say: The company promised to investigate the complaint and take appropriate action within a week.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
We apologize about any inconvenience this may caused.
We apology for any inconvenience this may have cause.
We apologize any inconvenience this may have caused.
answer: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

wrong.We apologize about any inconvenience thi: may 後面要接原形或 have + p.p.，不能直接接 caused。
wrong.We apology for any inconvenience this ma: apology 是名詞，動詞要用 apologize；have 後面要用 caused。
wrong.We apologize any inconvenience this may: apologize 是不及物動詞，後面要加 for 才能接原因。

why: apologize for 事情；may have + p.p. 表示可能已經造成。
say: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

prompt: 記者問公司會不會公開調查結果，你想回答：「調查完成後，我們會公布結果。」哪一句最自然？
options: We will release the findings once the investigation is complete.
We will release the findings once the investigation will be complete.
We release the findings once the investigation completed will.
We will be release the findings once the investigation is complete.
answer: We will release the findings once the investigation is complete.

wrong.We will release the findings once the in: once 引導的時間子句用現在式，不能再加 will。
wrong.We release the findings once the investi: will 放在句尾，時態與語序都錯誤。
wrong.We will be release the findings once the: will be 後面不能接原形 release。

why: 主句用 will 表示承諾，once 子句用現在式。
tip: once 子句和 when 一樣，用現在式。
say: We will release the findings once the investigation is complete.

text: The firm has taken full responsibility for the error and offered refunds to all affected customers.
options: 公司對錯誤承擔全部責任，並提供受影響的客戶退款。
公司否認錯誤，並拒絕任何退款。
公司要求受影響的客戶自己負責。
公司只退款給部分客戶。
answer: 公司對錯誤承擔全部責任，並提供受影響的客戶退款。

wrong.公司否認錯誤，並拒絕任何退款。: take full responsibility 是承擔全部責任，offered refunds 是提供退款，與否認相反。
wrong.公司要求受影響的客戶自己負責。: 責任由公司承擔，不是客戶。
wrong.公司只退款給部分客戶。: all affected customers 指所有受影響的客戶，不是部分。

why: take responsibility 是承擔責任，all affected customers 是所有受影響的客戶。
say: The firm has taken full responsibility for the error and offered refunds to all affected customers.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: To rebuild public _____, the company hired an independent group to review its safety procedures.
options: trust
truth
trade
track

wrong.truth: truth 是「真相」，rebuild truth 搭配不自然。
wrong.trade: trade 是「貿易」，不是重建的對象。
wrong.track: track 是「軌道、追蹤」，與重建公眾信心無關。

why: 請外部團體檢查安全，是為了重建大眾信任，rebuild trust 是常見搭配。
say: To rebuild public trust, the company hired an independent group to review its safety procedures.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The company recalled the product after several complaints were received.
The company recalled the product after several complaints received.
The company was recalled the product after several complaints were received.
The company recalls the product after several complaints were receiving.
answer: The company recalled the product after several complaints were received.

wrong.The company recalled the product after s: complaints 是被收到，需要被動語態 were received。
wrong.The company was recalled the product aft: 公司是主動召回產品，不能用被動 was recalled。
wrong.The company recalls the product after se: were receiving 是進行式，complaint 不會自己接收，要用 were received。

why: 公司主動召回用主動式；投訴是被收到，用被動式。
tip: 想清楚誰做動作：主動或被動。
say: The company recalled the product after several complaints were received.
